about_page.title: About AuraCare Hospital
about_page.subtitle: Two decades of surgical precision, academic training, and patient-first healthcare values.
about_page.story_p: Founded in 2001, AuraCare started as a small cardiac clinic with a single dream: to elevate local surgery quality standards to global norms. Over 25 years, our research investments, clinical breakthroughs, and public health campaigns have expanded us into a 500-bed multi-specialty regional hub.
about_page.mission_desc: To offer safe, high-efficacy, and technologically integrated care to patients of all socio-economic profiles under strict ethical frameworks.
about_page.vision_desc: To be recognized globally as the absolute benchmark in personalized patient rehabilitation, scientific teaching, and compassionate care.
about_page.v1_desc: Clinical decisions are driven entirely by proven evidence-based medical research.
about_page.v2_desc: Transparent pricing structure with absolutely no over-diagnoses or hidden markups.
about_page.v3_desc: We keep abreast of cutting-edge research, adapting surgical automation and robotic aids.
about_page.v4_desc: We preserve patient dignity with soft-spoken hospitality and dedicated family support rooms.
about_page.timeline_e1_desc: Inaugurated as an outpatient specialty cardiology clinic with 10 diagnostic beds.
about_page.timeline_e2_desc: Constructed our flagship 5-story medical wing adding Neurology and advanced Orthoplasties.
about_page.timeline_e3_desc: Pioneered computerized robotic-assistant knee surgeries and minimal incision bypass options.
about_page.timeline_e4_desc: Configured cloud-assisted digital neural networks detecting acute strokes 3x faster in MRI scans.
about_page.impact_desc: We believe healthcare is a basic human right. Every quarter, our mobile health units travel to rural sites, providing free screenings, diabetic therapeutics, and maternal checkups.
